# Stage 1: Intake

## The idea in the submitter's words (verbatim, do not edit)

> 1. Launching token 2. Singularity paired w/ Frontier index. Then we make it the canonical AI meme pairing coin. Make a website that shows all of the pairs etc 3. Do some shit with an AI agent at the helm with creator fees. Could probably run back Accelerando idea in some regards 4. Milady but for AI agents

## Restated without expansion

The note is four loosely linked moves, not one product. The gist (scope) has **not** arrived yet, so this record uses only what the founder said plus the Nov 24 token lookups.

| Element | Statement |
|---|---|
| Problem | **Not stated by the founder.** Not invented here. |
| Who has it (specific segment) | **Not stated.** Implied audience: AI-memecoin traders and holders on Solana. Unconfirmed. |
| Proposed solution | (1) launch a token; (2) pair it with Singularity and a "Frontier index", become the "canonical AI meme pairing coin", plus a website listing all the pairs; (3) an AI agent runs the creator fees (Accelerando-style); (4) an AI-agent version of Milady. |
| Why now | Not stated. Observed: AI Frontier is already used as a quote asset (BUBBLE, BUTTHOLE, Frongus quote in FRONTIER). |
| How it makes money (as submitted) | Blank. Implied: creator fees and token value. Not stated, so none is assumed. |
| Token involved? | yes |

**Assumptions to confirm from the gist:** Singularity = `7R4MP6...epump` (Solana, pump.fun); Frontier index = AI Frontier `58QyXQ...dfUhZ` (unconfirmed it is an index); Accelerando = `HiNkp9...ypump`. "Pair" = quote asset or liquidity pair (unconfirmed).

## Hypotheses to test (each must be falsifiable)

| ID | Hypothesis | What would kill it | Stage that tests it |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | Nothing equivalent exists for this segment (a pairing coin plus pairs site; an agent-run creator-fee coin; an agent-identity Milady) | Any product or native feature doing the core job, with traction | 2 |
| H2 | A new coin can become the "canonical" quote asset for AI memecoins | Quote assets win by existing liquidity and flow, and the current AI quote assets are small or lack organic volume | 3, 4 |
| H3 | A pairs-listing site gets used and has a payer | DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, Pump.fun or terminals already show quoted pairs, or no one pays | 2, 4, 5 |
| H4 | An AI agent controlling creator fees adds value users want, beyond what Clanker, Agency, Metaplex and Pump.fun already ship | Those products have no traction, or the agent adds nothing a fee split does not | 2, 3, 4 |
| H5 | The token has a necessary role (not just a ticker) | Fails `research/token-economics/token-necessity-test.md` | 5 |
| H6 | An AI-agent Milady has demand beyond Milady's own AGENTS drop | AGENTS already occupies it, or agent PFP collections show no volume | 2, 4 |
| H7 | The reference tokens are healthy enough to pair with | Singularity is 4 days old with falling volume and holders; Accelerando is dead; Frontier is unconfirmed | 3 |

## Keyword expansion for the existence check

1. quote token / quote asset / base pair for memecoins
2. custom pairs (Pump.fun), non-SOL pairs
3. AI memecoin index / basket / ETF-style index token
4. AI agent token launchpad / tokenized agent
5. agent-managed treasury / creator-fee buyback agent
6. AI agent identity NFT / ERC-8004 / ERC-8041 / agent PFP
7. pair explorer / pairs screener / ratio tracker (e.g. FRONTIER-quoted pairs)
8. AI religion / agent cult token (Accelerando style, Truth Terminal, Fartcoin lineage)
9. Mayhem Mode, Clanker, Agency, Metaplex agents, Virtuals, ai16z/elizaOS
10. Milady / Remilia / CULT, "Milady for X" clones

## Gate 1

PASS with a caveat: it is searchable, but it is four ideas in one and the problem and revenue model are missing. Validate each as a component and judge the bundle last. The gist may change the framing; if it does, reopen intake.
